title: Generated LAYOUT body recovery profile
scope: Malformed LAYOUT OBJECTS-body recovery and CLI disposition across six locally generated DWG revisions.

selection.source: P6-F typed OBJECTS parser and writer inventory
selection.reason: LAYOUT has bounded typed parser/writer routes at all six revisions and was missing from the malformed-body CLI matrix.

source.provenance: Generated from scratch by the in-tree dwg_local_roundtrip test writer and removed by the test runner.
source.profile: The valid control contains an ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary mapping one paper-space LAYOUT to its reserved block record. For the malformed profile, the dictionary instead maps a separate valid sentinel LAYOUT; the target LAYOUT frame remains present as raw bytes, followed by a LINE sentinel.
source.mutation: The generator searches within the bounded target LAYOUT body for a one-bit change rejected by DRW_Layout::parseDwg while preserving its common OBJECTS prologue and handle.

assertions: All six generated sources continue through the following LINE and report one failed OBJECTS frame, zero entity parse failures, and balanced source/published/failed frame accounting.

At AC1027, strict and explicit-partial output preserve the destination and refuse at the existing source-reference gate.
